red_team.case_for_morning: The only new fact makes a meeting more likely: Ushakov says it 'has been decided that they will meet', 'certainly' on Thursday 'immediately afterward' the plenary, possibly several times, adding to Peskov's 16 Nov line that a separate bilateral is being arranged. red_team.case_for_larger: Ushakov describes informal encounters, not a scheduled bilateral: he names the gala dinner and the plenary, both excluded, then 'immediately afterward' and 'sitting ... or simply standing' — the language of a pull-aside. Two days after Peskov spoke of a separate bilateral, there is still no time or venue and no White House confirmation; Thursday is taken by the trilateral. A standing chat would be reported as a brief conversation and resolve NO: about 0.36–0.42.
red_team.verdict: The case for a larger cut is somewhat stronger: the new fact raises the chance they meet at all but points to encounter types the criterion excludes, and falls short of a fixed bilateral.
